## Goal
- Complete the "FINAL IVX IA CHAT EXECUTION MODE" mandate: remove all narrative planning responses for developer requests, make chat an execution console returning HTTP 202 + strict 9-field executionStatus payload, build+deploy+verify+APK. Prior completed work: Phase 8 QA, IVX IA chat routing fixes #1–#4, owner chat open-on-latest scroll fix.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_SENSITIVE_OPERATION, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — must use Install tool
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — large files >~30KB MUST use gzip-base64; Python `zlib.compress(raw, 9, 31)` (wbits=31 = gzip format); omit `contentEncoding` for small files
- Render deploy API: same action endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login; length ~1620; expires frequently — re-mint as needed; refreshToken at `/tmp/owner_rt`)
- `/tmp/` files get wiped by sandbox resets — recreate via heredoc each time; use project-local paths like `backend/scripts/` for persistent scripts
- Watchman refuses to start in low-priority sandbox (nice_value=19) — must exclude from PATH via `/tmp/nowatch` dir with shim script that exits 1
- Generated TypeScript code embedded inside outer template literals is DANGEROUS — `${...}` in generated code is eagerly evaluated by outer template → ReferenceError → worker crash. MUST use array-join with string concatenation instead
- `pkill` commands cause shell exit code 128 in this sandbox — use `kill -9 <pid>` or `ps -ef | grep` + manual kill instead
- `bun test backend/` = 1521 tests across 111 files (~2.7s); `bunx tsc --noEmit` at root for full typecheck
- Gradle builds exceed 60s tool timeout — must run with `nohup env PATH=/tmp/nowatch:$PATH ./gradlew assembleRelease --build-cache --stacktrace > /tmp/gradle-build-1.4.14.log 2>&1 &` then poll PID + log tail + APK mtime/size
- APK presign upload API: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` returns `uploadUrl` (900s expiry); PUT raw bytes with `Content-Type: application/vnd.android.package-archive`; S3 ETag matches local md5 when successful
- `buildOwnerAIResponsePayloadInner` constructs response by explicitly listing each field from `internalMetadata` — MUST add new fields to this explicit list or they will be constructed but silently dropped (caused `executionStatus: ABSENT` bug)

  - New `backend/ivx-execution-mode.test.ts` — 26 tests (10 categories, narrative gate, 9-field payload, forbidden phrases)
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` — replaced 55s blocking poll with 12s warmup + 8s terminal wait; returns HTTP 202 immediately for running jobs, HTTP 200 for terminal; `executionStatus` payload attached to response; forbidden narrative phrases stripped from answer
  - `expo/shared/ivx/types.ts` — added `IVXExecutionStatusPayload` + `IVXExecutionEvidence` to `IVXOwnerAIResponse`

  - New `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/components/ExecutionConsoleBubble.tsx` — console bubble UI with progress bar, stage indicator, files list, tests, commitSha, deployId, verified evidence block

  - Bumped to v1.4.14(46), buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_19_BUILD_46_IVX_IA_CHAT_EXECUTION_MODE`
  - Backend tests 1521 pass / 0 fail; `bun x tsc --noEmit` 0 errors
  - 11 files committed via owner-gated GitHub API → GitHub HEAD `bb4259a77c5cbd14bb54a3103310ff882751e877`; Render deploy triggered; 3-way SHA parity verified
  - **CRITICAL BUG CAUGHT + FIXED**: Live routing test revealed `executionStatus: ABSENT` — `buildOwnerAIResponsePayloadInner` explicitly lists each field from `internalMetadata` but I forgot to add `executionStatus` to that list. Fixed by adding `executionStatus: internalMetadata.executionStatus` to the response object. Committed as `f374b2bf85fc612cba5e7b510656d790d79e40ed`; re-deployed; 3-way SHA parity re-verified
  - **Live execution-mode routing test PASSED**: HTTP 200, `model: ivx_self_developer_runtime`, `executionStatus` present with all 9 fields: taskId `ivx-worker-535cb3e5-f0c9-4cf9-80c0-cd0efb65d79b`, status `blocked`, stage `FAILED`, category `audit`, httpStatus 200, tests `{run: true, passed: true}`, evidence with `finalStatus: BLOCKED` (honest — worker ran tests PASS + /health 200 but no code change required)
  - APK v1.4.14(46): 84,551,684 bytes, md5 `f20d73733f32a1a430b26a0e37a3d841`, live at https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.14.apk, S3 ETag matches ✓. (Backend-only fix `f374b2bf` doesn't affect APK bundle — Expo-side changes already in the APK.)

## Key Decisions
- Replaced 55s blocking poll with 12s warmup + 8s terminal wait because the owner-required behavior is HTTP 202 immediately with taskId; the old approach held the HTTP connection for nearly a minute and looked like a hung chat
- `executionStatus` stored in side-channel `executionStatusByMessageId` Map (not on `IVXMessage` itself) to avoid widening the Supabase DB schema; the renderMessage callback reads this map to decide whether to render `ExecutionConsoleBubble` vs plain `MessageBubble`
- Explanation escape hatch in classifier fires BEFORE category matchers so "what is the difference between fix and build?" is treated as a pure question, not an execution command; uses `ACTION_IMPERATIVE_TAIL_PATTERN` (only matches "then fix/deploy/..." at end) not broad `and <verb>` which caught noun phrases
- `buildOwnerAIResponsePayloadInner` constructs response by explicitly listing each field — new fields MUST be added to this list or they silently drop (caused `executionStatus: ABSENT` bug caught by live test)
- Backend-only fixes (like the `executionStatus` field copy) don't require an APK rebuild — only Expo-side changes affect the JS bundle
- Converted `pendingInitialScrollRef` from ref to React state because refs don't trigger re-renders and a single retry can fail silently
- expo/package.json remains at 1.4.8 because the system blocks direct `package.json` edits; version bumped in `app.config.ts` and `android/app/build.gradle` instead
